agreement: Maintainer, 3 Nov 2026: 14:40 agreement to recompile MoltenVK or replace its kept binary; 15:04 go-ahead for this workflow and its runs; 15:23 'keep the latest MoltenVK library, the most recent one'.
why: v1.4.2 (newest Khronos release) enables MTLResidencySet on iOS 18 (mvkOSVersionIsAtLeast(15.0, 18.0, 2.0), Apple6 GPUs) and defers useResource in deduplicated lists, which removes upstream the per-descriptor walk measured in 629; the RewindBox argument buffer patch written for 1.4.0 no longer applies and is retired. MVKConfiguration is unchanged from 1.4.0.
patchMarkers: RewindBox drawable ownership: taken by each present, guarded by _mtlDrawableLock
RewindBox cache size: entry sizes counted once and kept on each shader library
RewindBox mapped cache data: compressed MSL referenced in the mapped file, not copied
patchWhy: MVKPresentableSwapchainImage drawable ownership (KhronosGroup/MoltenVK#2791, open, no upstream fix): acquireAndSignalWhenAvailable released _mtlDrawable without a lock on the vkAcquireNextImageKHR thread while, with MeloNX's asynchronous queue submission, the image's earlier present read it and copied it into its Metal handler blocks on the submission thread (SIGSEGV objc_retain <- _Block_copy <- MTLDispatchListAppendBlock <- presentCAMetalDrawable, Super Mario 3D World, vsync unbounded, IPA 718). Each present now takes its drawable under _mtlDrawableLock and its completion handler releases it; acquisition releases nothing; nextDrawable is never called with the lock held. Model and sanitizer checks: test/melonx_moltenvk_drawable_ownership_test.py. Also (lot 9, second part): MVKPipelineCache::countData() counts each entry's serialized size once and keeps it on its shader library, so the size query RewindBox asks during play no longer serializes every entry again (IPA 718 Hogwarts: 2 461 ms for 4 667 entries). macOS bench run 42811818840: 480 queries 24.6-24.9 ms -> 2.1-2.7 ms, same 8 826 110 bytes and data hash, VK_INCOMPLETE kept for a short buffer, reload size equal. Also (lot 9, third part, RAM): a private pNext structure of VkPipelineCacheCreateInfo (sType 0x52425831, 'RBX1') makes vkCreatePipelineCache reference each library's compressed MSL in the caller's data instead of copying it into the heap (MVKCompressor keeps an external pointer; MVKShaderLibrary's copy keeps it, so merges into main keep the reference; any new compression or a load without the structure owns its bytes as before; the cache data written is byte-identical). RewindBox passes it for the main snapshot only and keeps that read-only mapping until main is destroyed (adapt_pipeline_cache_mapped_data). macOS bench run 42818483337 (44 MB cache, 2 400 pipelines): +77.8 MiB at load copied, +32.4 MiB referenced; 246 vs 199 MiB after the pipelines; same bytes written, 0 missing, 0 SPIR-V compiled. Not measured on an iPhone.
